categories.name: Security
items: Secrets or API keys are not hardcoded in the repository.
File and network inputs are validated or constrained.
Dependencies look reasonable (no obviously malicious packages).

categories.name: Performance
items: Large data is not reloaded on every Streamlit interaction without caching.
Charts/tables are appropriate for the data volume described.

categories.name: Testing & docs
items: README explains how to install and run the project.
If tests exist, they cover critical logic or edge cases.

categories.name: UX & correctness
items: Dashboard layout is readable; KPIs match the domain story.
Errors (missing files, bad JSON) are handled or surfaced clearly.
